text: I think you'll enjoy this One Dish Chicken and Bows recipe, given your fondness for pasta dishes and chicken. The presence of sweet red pepper, a flavor combination you seem to appreciate, and the relatively short cooking time of 25 minutes may also appeal to you. While the recipe doesn't feature mushrooms or walnuts, which are staples in many of your liked recipes, the creamy sauce and parmesan cheese might be a nice departure from your usual flavors.
